an7.71:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] bhāvanaṃ ananuyuttassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
an7.71:1.2: aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyā’ti.
an7.71:1.3: atha khvassa neva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
an7.71:1.7: catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ, catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ, catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ, pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ, pañcannaṃ balānaṃ, sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ, ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa.
an7.71:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā,
an7.71:2.2: tānassu kukkuṭiyā na sammā adhisayitāni na sammā pariseditāni na sammā paribhāvitāni.
an7.71:2.3: kiñcāpi tassā kukkuṭiyā evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
an7.71:2.4: “aho vata me kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyyunti.”
an7.71:2.5: atha kho abhabbāva te kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjituṃ.
an7.71:2.7: tathā hi bhikkhave kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni na sammā adhisayitāni na sammā pariseditāni, na sammā paribhāvitāni,
an7.71:2.8: evameva kho bhikkhave bhāvanaṃ ananuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
an7.71:2.9: aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyāti.
an7.71:2.10: atha khvassa neva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
an7.71:3.1: bhāvanaṃ anuyuttassa bhikkhave, bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi na evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
an7.71:3.2: aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyāti,
an7.71:3.3: atha khvassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
an7.71:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā,
an7.71:4.2: tānassu kukkuṭiyā sammā adhisayitāni sammā pariseditāni sammā paribhāvitāni.
an7.71:4.3: kiñcāpi tassā kukkuṭiyā na evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
an7.71:4.4: aho vata me kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyyunti.
an7.71:4.5: atha kho bhabbāva te kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjituṃ.
an7.71:4.7: tathāhi bhikkhave kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni sammā adhisayitāni sammā pariseditāni, sammā paribhāvitāni.
an7.71:4.8: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhāvanaṃ anuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi na evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
an7.71:4.9: aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyāti.
an7.71:4.10: atha khvassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
an7.71:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, palagaṇḍassa vā palagaṇḍantevāsikassa vā dissanteva vāsijaṭe aṅgulipadāni dissati aṅguṭṭhapadaṃ. no ca khvāssa evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti: ettakaṃ vā me ajja vāsijaṭassa khīṇaṃ, ettakaṃ bhiyyo, ettakaṃ pareti. atha khvāssa khīṇe khīṇantveva ñāṇaṃ hoti.
an7.71:5.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhāvanaṃ anuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi na evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti: ettakaṃ vā me ajja āsavānaṃ khīṇaṃ, ettakaṃ vā bhiyyo, ettakaṃ vā pareti. atha khvāssa khīṇe khīṇantveva ñāṇaṃ hoti.
an7.71:6.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, sāmuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabaddhāya chammāsāni udake pariyādāya hemantikena thale ukkhittāya vātātapaparetāni bandhanāni tāni pāvussakena meghena ahippavaṭṭāni appakasireneva paṭippassambhanti pūtikāni bhavanti,
an7.71:6.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhāvanaṃ anuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato appakasireneva saṃyojanāni paṭippassambhanti pūtikāni bhavantīti.
